facts.title: near hit during start-up after maintenance on V-4110

response.consequence: The recorded outcome was no injury or loss. The potential outcome was rated 1 against the site's consequence scale, above the 0 actually realised.

defences.finding: Control BUND_AND_DRAINAGE_CONTAINMENT: the secondary containment by bund and drainage was in place but did not perform, and the accident investigation classified this as a task or environmental condition.

Control HYDROCARBON_TRANSFER_CONTROL: the controlled transfer of hydrocarbon between vessels was in place but did not perform, and the accident investigation classified this as an individual or team action.

Control SEAL_SUPPORT_SYSTEM_INTEGRITY: the integrity of the mechanical seal support system was never verified as effective, and the accident investigation classified this as an absent or failed defence.

recommendations: Restore the integrity of the mechanical seal support system on V-4110, PSV-4110 and PSV-4111 and record the spot check before this task is next authorised.
response.sequence: Work was under way in responding to a loss of containment, specifically isolating and depressuring a leaking system. V-4110 (hydrocarbon day tanks and surge vessel) is in service for diesel and light hydrocarbon day storage, discharge surge suppression. The task proceeded during start-up after maintenance while the secondary containment by bund and drainage was in place but did not perform. The chemical energy involved is held as hydrocarbon, and the recorded presentation was fire, toxic exposure, corrosive contact, detonation.
response.summary: On 24 June 2009 a near hit was recorded on V-4110, PSV-4110 and PSV-4111 at Marrindal Concentrator and Hydrocarbon Transfer Facility during start-up after maintenance; chemical energy held as hydrocarbon was not released.
